title: You Are Not in Charge of Everyone's Weather
core_idea: Letting go can mean releasing the habit of managing other people's moods, so we can be kind without carrying feelings that belong to someone else.
text: Some of us walk into a room and immediately read the weather. Who is tense. Who is quiet. Who might need calming down. And without a word, we start adjusting ourselves to keep everyone comfortable. It can look like kindness, and often it began as a way to stay safe. But other people's moods were never yours to steer. You can care about someone without carrying what they feel. You can offer warmth and still let their storm be theirs. Today, if you notice yourself scanning a room, try one small thing. Take a breath, feel your own feet, and ask quietly: what is my weather right now? That question belongs to you.
description: A gentle reflection on letting go of managing everyone's moods, and returning to your own inner weather.
